parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 15.5 - Summer Event! - 29 July 2023

Overview

Millie is a ​MythicalMythical Limited unit​. She can only be obtained via summons​ in Limited-Time Event Banner.

Evolving

Millie can evolve into Millie (Holy) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Millie
x1 Soul Gem (Gold)
Result
Millie (Holy)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5,000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
